cases.sentence: Некоторое время спустя виночерпий и пекарь ___ провинились перед своим господином, царем Египта.

cases.translation: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

cases.translation: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.
